sentences.text: Counsel appearing for the petitioner made a prayer that the petitioner may be granted compensation of an amount of Rs.6,12,342=00 for expenses of treatment of his son.
Further prayer is made to provide appropriate relief to the petitioner in accordance with Rehabilitation Scheme of 2002.

It is argued that the Collector in its order has directed that respondent No.4 may consider the case of the petitioner for granting appointment to one of the members of the family as Ravi Rathore who was member of petitioner's family died during the course of employment.
2. Heard the counsel for the petitioner.
3. Petitioner does not have any right to claim compensation for burns suffered by his son.
Petitioner's son had himself tried to immolate himself.
Respondent Company in order to discharge it's social corporate responsibility has taken the petitioner's son for treatment at various places and has incurred expenditure for treatment.
Respondent No.4, in no way can be held liable for tortuous act which has been committed by the petitioner's son.
Therefore, prayer made by the petitioner for grant of compensation is declined and petition is dismissed in respect of prayer made in Clause 7.2 of the petition.
4. Petitioner has made further prayer that petitioner be granted benefit of Rehabilitation Scheme of 2002 and proposed policy of 2010.
Collector has already passed an order in favour of the petitioner to consider the case of the petitioner for grant of employment to any family member of the petitioner.
The said order has not been challenged by respondent No.4 or by State Government.

5. In view of the aforesaid, the writ petition is disposed of directing respondent No.4 to consider fresh representation of the petitioner for grant of employment to any member of his family in accordance with the Rehabilitation Policy of 2002.
Respondent No.4 shall pass order on representation of the petitioner in accordance with law within a period of 90 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
With the aforesaid direction, writ petition is disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.
